Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.item

Class Equipment

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.item.Item
com.epitech.depthdiablo.item.Equipment
All Implemented Interfaces:
BuildModifier
Direct Known Subclasses:
Armor, Weapon
public abstract class Equipment extends Item implements BuildModifier
An item the player equips in a portrait slot: a weapon or an armor (GDD 1.3.1, 2.2).

Each equipment is a BuildModifier: it changes the build of the character who holds it.

  • Constructor Details

    • Equipment

      protected Equipment(String id, String nameKey, String spriteId, Rarity rarity, int price)
      Creates an equipment.
      Parameters:
      id - the item's key in the data files
      nameKey - the translation key of its name
      spriteId - the picture the renderer draws for it
      rarity - its loot tier; never Rarity.CONSUMABLE or Rarity.PASSIVE
      price - its shop price in coins; 0 means free
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if a text or the rarity is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if a text is blank, the price is negative or the rarity is CONSUMABLE
